authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 80 bundler wallets out of 101 traders, and the top bundler traders hold 25.6%. The bot/degen rate is 38%. On the organic side, 107 unique buyers vs 88 sellers in the last hour, top-10 holders at 29%, dev holds 0% and there are no paid boosts. I found no X, Telegram or Reddit posts about this contract.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is essentially invisible to search. The d/acc tokens launched about 2 hours later (56k h1 volume) suggest some live X trigger that I couldn't find.

structured_output.counterargument: Several d/acc clones launched in the last 1-2 hours, one with $56k in hourly volume, so a live d/acc/e/acc meme is probably circulating on X right now. This token is the oldest and most liquid of the batch. At a $16k market cap it needs only about $32k to double, and it is already rising fast (+80% in 30 minutes) with buyers outnumbering sellers. That is plenty of room for a quick 2x on the curve.

structural_risks: Heavy bundler presence (80 tagged wallets, top bundler traders hold 25.6%)
Deployer is a mass-launch factory (22,549 tokens), so no one is committed to the project
Competing d/acc tickers are splitting attention
On the bonding curve at 65.75/115 SOL, so insiders can dump into the curve
